meta.name: The World's Strongest Witch
meta.description: Cast out by her aristocratic family after manifesting a seemingly useless skill, Lorna discovers her ability, “Internet,” is an SSS-rank cheat that grants her access to the entirety of the world’s knowledge. All Lorna wants is a peaceful life, but as she collects rare gear and potent items, the “world’s weakest witch” suddenly becomes very powerful, landing in one chaotic adventure after another.

videos.title: I Tried Using the Internet!
videos.overview: Lorna goes on an adventure with her skill, the Internet, which grants her access to near infinite knowledge.

videos.title: I Tried Becoming an Adventurer!
videos.overview: Lorna arrives in Aiphoné and goes to register with the adventurer's guild.

videos.title: I Tried Looking At Message Boards!
videos.overview: Lorna must overcome a dungeon considered impossible to complete if she wants to pass the exam.

videos.title: I Tried Stopping Someone's Ambition!
videos.overview: Lorna unexpectedly saves an elf and is taken to the hidden elven village plagued by a strange disease.

videos.title: I Tried Quitting Being a Savior!
videos.overview: While the elves celebrate the end of the plague, Lorna feels guilty about being revered as their Savior.

videos.title: I Tried Becoming a God!
videos.overview: Lorna visits the port town of Aquas and discovers why the townsfolk are terrified of Wednesdays.

videos.title: I Tried Making a Secret Weapon!
videos.overview: Lorna helps Aries complete the weekly Wednesday mission.
